mapper.select: SELECT TS.ID AS TEST_SET_ID , TS.SET_NAME , TS.TEST_TYPE , TP.TOTAL_POINT , MA.SCORE , MA.PENDING_COUNT , CA.AVERAGE_SCORE FROM TEST_SET TS INNER JOIN (SELECT TST.TEST_SET_ID , SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) AS TOTAL_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TST.TEST_SET_ID) TP ON TP.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT TA.TEST_SET_ID , AS SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{userId} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TA.TEST_SET_ID) MA ON MA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT SS.TEST_SET_ID , ROUND(AVG(SS.STUDENT_SCORE), 1) AS AVERAGE_SCORE FROM (SELECT TA.TEST_SET_ID , TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , AS STUDENT_SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CS.USER_ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND CS.USER_ID = TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID AND U.DEL_YN = 'N') GROUP BY TA.TEST_SET_ID , TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID) SS GROUP BY SS.TEST_SET_ID HAVING SUM(SS.PENDING_COUNT) = 0) CA ON CA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE TS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND TS.SHOW_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TS.ID ASC

SELECT CS.ID AS COURSE_STUDENT_ID , CS.USER_ID , U.NAME AS USER_NAME , TS.ID AS TEST_SET_ID , TS.SET_NAME , TS.TEST_TYPE , TP.TOTAL_POINT , SA.SCORE , SA.PENDING_COUNT FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CS.USER_ID INNER JOIN TEST_SET TS ON TS.COURSE_ID = CS.COURSE_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT TST.TEST_SET_ID , SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) AS TOTAL_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TST.TEST_SET_ID) TP ON TP.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID , AS SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID) SA ON SA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.USER_ID AND SA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY U.NAME ASC , TS.ID ASC
